observation_release_basis: USER_DECISION_2026_11_23: "完整过程是，相机先正对箱堆，然后机械臂正对箱堆准备抓取，然后机械臂逆时针旋转到落箱处（此时相机又面对箱堆，开始下一轮的观测，周而复始）"; "释放点改到-Y侧"; "初始的抓取姿态不变". The observation pose is the release pose and the frozen q_start (J1 ~81.6 deg: camera faces the stack, arm points to -Y); four-segment cycle approach/contact/detach/loaded return/release at q_start; supersedes cycle_structure START_RELEASE_SEPARATE for this field run. Removed cycle_structure: {"mode": "START_RELEASE_SEPARATE", "release_j1_offset_deg": -180.0, "transfer_j1": "CLOCKWISE", "return_j1": "COUNTERCLOCKWISE", "basis": "USER_DECISION_2026_11_22: start from q_start S (original start with J6 rotated 180 deg clockwise, 2026-11-21 (1)); approach, contact, detach, loaded transfer clockwise to the release pose R = S with J1 rotated 180 deg clockwise (2026-11-21 (4)); release; return counter-clockwise from R to S for the next round. Observation at S with the existing (unrotated) camera mounting."}
